blocks.text: The challenge of e-commerce merchandising on Mac

You likely spend your day moving between Shopify, Cin7 Core, and various vendor portals. Each platform has a different interface and requires a unique set of steps to update product descriptions or adjust inventory levels. This creates what many call channel sprawl. You are constantly shifting your mental context, which makes it hard to keep a rhythm.

When you manage hundreds or thousands of SKUs, even small errors in data entry can cause problems. You might need to check competitor pricing while updating your own listings in a separate tab. If you lose track of which window holds which data, you waste time finding your spot again. Lazur helps by keeping an eye on your screen while you work.
How Lazur changes your product catalog management workflow

Lazur lives in your Mac notch, waiting for you to hold a key. When you hold ⌥ ⌘, you can ask about anything visible on your screen. If you cannot remember where a specific setting is in your Shopify admin panel, ask Lazur. It will draw a circle around the button or menu item you need.

If you need to perform a multi-step task, like updating a series of product tags, ask Lazur to guide you. It provides instructions one click at a time. You perform the action, and Lazur waits for you to finish before moving to the next step. This keeps you on track without you needing to memorize every menu path in every app.
Managing admin tasks and email without the drain

Email is often the biggest drain on your time. You spend hours triaging support tickets in Gorgias or responding to vendor inquiries. Instead of typing every response from scratch, use the fn key to dictate text. Lazur handles the formatting so you can get back to your catalog updates faster.

Because Lazur runs on your Mac, you can ask it to summarize long email threads or research competitor pricing in a separate Chrome tab. You can stay in your primary workspace while Lazur gathers the information you need. It summarizes the findings so you can make decisions without leaving your current task.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is designed to guide you and point at things, but it does not perform actions within other applications. It helps you find the right place to click.

faq.question: Can Lazur access my private store data?
faq.answer: Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut key. It does not store your content, and it is not used to train AI models.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently only available for macOS on Apple silicon and Intel. A Windows version is planned for the future.
